properties.name: Mariana Butte Golf Course
properties.blurb: A public, city-owned 18-hole course along the Big Thompson River with sweeping Front Range views — one of the lifestyle perks of calling Loveland home.
properties.videoTitle: Mariana Butte Golf Course — Loveland, CO

properties.blurb: Lodging, trails and winter activities up at Red Feather. This is the honest answer to "what would we actually do up there in February".

properties.blurb: Farm-to-table in historic downtown Erie. When someone asks me what there is to eat in Erie, this is the first name out of my mouth.

properties.blurb: Street tacos and serious tequila at The Foundry, right in downtown Loveland. Come on a Friday night if you want to know what this downtown is actually like.
